primary.poolable_reason: TWO COMPOSITES, NOT ONE ESTIMAND. Registered primaries read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-19. FOURIER (NCT01764633, n=27,564) registers 'Time to Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina, Stroke, or Coronary Revascularization'. ODYSSEY OUTCOMES (NCT01663402, n=18,924) registers 'Time to First Occurrence of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event (MACE)', defined in its own description as CHD death, non-fatal MI, fatal and non-fatal ischaemic stroke, or unstable angina requiring hospitalisation. THEY DIFFER ON THREE AXES: FOURIER counts ALL CARDIOVASCULAR death against ODYSSEY's CHD death; FOURIER counts ALL stroke against ODYSSEY's ISCHAEMIC stroke; and FOURIER COUNTS CORONARY REVASCULARISATION, WHICH ODYSSEY DOES NOT. Revascularisation is the highest-frequency component in this class of trial, so this is not a rounding difference in the event definition -- it changes what is being counted. P37: composite names are not definitions. SEPARATELY, the estimator was DerSimonian-Laird at k=2, and DL is refused below k=10 in this project because its tau-squared is badly biased with few studies. AND THE OBJECT ALREADY SAID SO: it carried estimand_established=false and a poolable_reason stating the estimate had been RECOVERED from the page rather than established. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- undertake or display a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged sufficiently similar to ensure a clinically meaningful answer.

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.estimator: REML with Hartung-Knapp, t on k-1 = 1 degree(s) of freedom (t = 12.7062)
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED: The published point is 0.8440 and the house-rule point is 0.8440. THE NUMBER A READER REMEMBERS DOES NOT MOVE; what differs is the precision claim. That is why nothing downstream catches this -- every memorable quantity survives.

published_interval.estimator: DerSimonian-Laird inverse-variance on extracted effect estimates

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.variance_inflation_floor: A FLOOR OF 1 IS APPLIED TO THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR so the adjustment can never NARROW an interval below the unadjusted one. That guard is the recognised modification for exactly this instability, and its existence is evidence the small-k behaviour is a KNOWN problem with KNOWN handling rather than a novel judgement.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.no_rule_is_decided_here: The house rule is REML with Hartung-Knapp below k=10, settled days ago. Whether it means ALWAYS or WITH A FLOOR AT k=3 is a decision about this corpus, not a computation, and it has been referred rather than taken. BOTH INTERVALS STAND ON THIS PAGE UNTIL IT IS MADE. Nothing is unpublished and no reader is left with only the narrower one.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.what_this_means_for_this_pool: THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES 1 AND THE HOUSE-RULE INTERVAL CROSSES IT. A SIGNIFICANCE VERDICT TURNS ON THE INTERVAL METHOD ALONE. A reader shown only the published interval has been told something firmer than the evidence supports; a reader shown only the wider one loses that the contributing trials agree. BOTH ARE HERE.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.read_the_width_with_care: AT k=2 HARTUNG-KNAPP USES t ON ONE DEGREE OF FREEDOM -- 12.7062 against the normal 1.9600 -- and the interval is enormously wider. That width is a property of the method at very few studies, not a measurement of this evidence. It is recorded so a reader can see it; it is NOT presented as the better interval.

primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. primary.poolable_reason: THE TWO TRIALS DO NOT SHARE ONE ENDPOINT, AND ONE WHOLE COMPONENT IS PRESENT IN ONE AND ABSENT FROM THE OTHER. FOURIER's primary, verbatim from its registry record, is 'Time to Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina, Stroke, or CORONARY REVASCULARIZATION'. ODYSSEY OUTCOMES' primary is a MACE composite its record defines as 'Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) death, non-fatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), fatal and non-fatal ischemic stroke (IS), or unstable angina (UA) requiring hospitalization' -- WITH NO REVASCULARIZATION COMPONENT AT ALL. Coronary revascularization is the most frequent component of FOURIER's composite, so this is not a wording difference: one trial counts a class of event the other does not count. THREE FURTHER DIFFERENCES, each on the face of the records: FOURIER counts CARDIOVASCULAR death while ODYSSEY counts CORONARY HEART DISEASE death, which is a subset of it; FOURIER counts STROKE of any type while ODYSSEY counts ISCHAEMIC stroke only; FOURIER counts MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION while ODYSSEY counts NON-FATAL myocardial infarction only. SEPARATELY AND SUFFICIENT ON ITS OWN: every per-trial value in this object was an ODDS RATIO DERIVED BY US from 2x2 counts, while both trials analyse time to first occurrence by Kaplan-Meier and report hazard ratios.

Coronary revascularization is the most frequent component of FOURIER's composite, so this is not a wording difference: one trial counts a class of event the other does not count. pooled.withdrawn_note: AND A THIRD DEFECT, ON THE INDEX RATHER THAN IN THE POOL. The card and the table row published 'HR 0.85 (0.79-0.92), k=2'. THIS OBJECT'S POOLED VALUE IS OR 0.8440 (0.7952 to 0.8958). The number on the index was never the number in the object -- it is a single trial's own reported hazard ratio, presented as a two-trial pooled result and labelled with a measure this review never computed. ARM LABELS ARE INVERTED ON BOTH TRIALS AND THAT IS NOT RESOLVED HERE. The arm carrying the role INTERVENTION is labelled 'Placebo' on FOURIER and 'Placebo' on ODYSSEY OUTCOMES, while the arms labelled 'Evolocumab' and 'Alirocumab 75 mg Q2W' carry the role CONTROL. An arm cannot be both the placebo and the intervention, so the object is self-contradictory on its face. WHICH HALF IS WRONG -- the label or the role -- needs each trial's own arm sizes and event counts from source, and is left open rather than guessed: the pooled estimate can be right in magnitude while every label a reader sees is on the wrong arm, which is exactly how EAST-AFNET 4's swapped arms survived on ABLATION_AF. The same inversion is present on six other trials across four objects and comes from the converter, not from this page. WHAT IS CONFIRMED: both trials are PCSK9 inhibitors against placebo in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, both adjudicated centrally and blind, both analysed as time to first event. The question this review asks is a real one and these are the right two trials for it. What cannot stand is averaging two composites when one of them counts revascularization and the other does not.

Both stated on their own registry records. The withdrawn HR 0.85 (0.79–0.92) was a single trial’s result shown as a two-trial pool; this review’s own pooled value was OR 0.8440

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
